subjects.description: What the primary subject(s) are, as seen in the source video
subjects.appearance_details: Preserve exact appearance, shape, color, size, and identity from the source video — do not invent details
subjects.relationship: Role and interaction with other subjects, identical to the source video
subjects.location: Position within the frame, identical to the source video
subjects.relative_size: Size relative to the frame, identical to the source video
subjects.orientation: Facing direction / orientation, identical to the source video
subjects.pose: Physical pose or configuration, identical to the source video
subjects.action: State plainly that motion and trajectory are identical to the source video — do not invent new motion or behavior
subjects.state_changes: State plainly that state changes and event timing are identical to the source video
subjects.number_of_subjects: Count of distinct subjects of this type

background_setting: Full environment description. Must state: 'The same structural layout and scene geometry as the source video' and 'All scene geometry, camera angle, and composition are preserved exactly.' Then describe the target appearance transformation applied to that environment.

environmental_transformation.target_condition: The target weather / time-of-day / environmental condition being applied
environmental_transformation.transformation_scope: What specifically changes — sky, exposure, ambient illumination, surface appearance, and other physically expected effects. Change only appearance, never structure or motion.
environmental_transformation.preservation_requirements: Restate: exact camera position, crop, perspective, field of view, scene geometry, subject identities, subject count, trajectories, speeds, relative spacing, and event timing must all be preserved from the source video.
prohibited_changes: List specific things that must NOT happen — e.g. do not alter subject trajectories or speeds, do not add/remove/duplicate/recolor subjects, do not change camera framing, do not introduce new objects or structures, do not revert to source-video conditions

lighting.conditions: Overall lighting condition after the transformation
lighting.illumination_effect: How the new lighting affects the scene's visibility and exposure
lighting.surface_conditions: How the target condition's effects (e.g. wetness, snow, dust) appear on the ground/surfaces, conforming to existing geometry
lighting.artificial_lighting: State of any artificial light sources (e.g. streetlights, headlights, signage) under the new condition

aesthetics.composition: Overall shot composition, matching the source video
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Overall mood conveyed by the new appearance
aesthetics.patterns: Recurring visual patterns or textures introduced or preserved

cinematography.camera_motion: State plainly that camera motion is identical to the source video
cinematography.framing: Shot framing, matching the source video
cinematography.camera_angle: Camera angle, matching the source video
cinematography.depth_of_field: Depth of field, matching the source video
cinematography.focus: Focus characteristics, matching the source video
cinematography.camera_preservation: State plainly: preserve the exact source camera — do not pan, tilt, zoom, crop, reframe, rotate, or alter perspective

control_guidance.control_type: The transfer control modality being used (e.g. Edge, Depth, Segmentation, Blur, WSM)
control_guidance.structure_priority: Instruct the model to use the control signal as strict structural guidance, preserving all subject silhouettes, boundaries, and scene structure throughout
control_guidance.appearance_freedom: List which attributes are allowed to change (e.g. lighting, weather, surface texture, color temperature) — appearance only, never structure or motion
control_guidance.motion_priority: Instruct that all subjects must follow their exact source-video trajectories; control guidance must never cause subjects to move differently than the source
control_guidance.temporal_consistency: Instruct that the new appearance must remain stable and consistent frame-to-frame — no flickering, shimmering, or drifting

artistic_style: Photorealistic style matching the target condition
context: One-sentence summary of what this transfer accomplishes and which control modality is used
negative_prompt: Comma-separated list of concepts to avoid — conditions that contradict the target condition, and anything that would alter structure, subject identity, or motion
audio_description: State plainly: preserve the original video audio without alteration, unless describing new ambient sound consistent with the target condition
